passage.label: Musa sent with signs and clear authority to Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun who called him magician and liar; when he brought truth they ordered the sons of believers killed and women kept alive, but their plan was in error; Pharaoh proposing to kill Musa while fearing he would change their religion or cause corruption; Musa seeking refuge in his Lord and theirs from every arrogant one who disbelieves the Day of Account; a believing man of Pharaoh's family concealing his faith arguing against killing a man for saying my Lord is Allah while bringing clear proofs, noting the liar bears his lie and the truthful brings part of what he promises, and that transgressors and liars are unguided; his appeal that today's dominance cannot shield from divine punishment against Pharaoh's claim to show only what he sees and guide to right conduct; his fear of a day like the companies, the custom of Nuh, Aad, Thamud and those after, with Allah wanting no injustice; his fear of the Day of Calling when backs turn in flight without protector or guide; Yusuf's earlier clear proofs met with lasting doubt until his death and the claim no messenger would follow, thus transgressors and skeptics left astray; disputation without authority hated by Allah and believers, hearts of arrogant tyrants sealed; Pharaoh ordering Haman to build a tower to reach the ways of the heavens and look at Musa's deity while thinking him a liar, his evil deed made attractive and his plan ending in ruin

arabicExcerpts.text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٞ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ
وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٖ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ

وَقَالَ رَجُلٞ مُّؤۡمِنٞ مِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقۡتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمۡۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبٗا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهُۥۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقٗا يُصِبۡكُم بَعۡضُ ٱلَّذِي يَعِدُكُمۡۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ كَذَّابٞ

يَٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأۡسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۚ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمۡ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهۡدِيكُمۡ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
مِثۡلَ دَأۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوحٖ وَعَادٖ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلۡمٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِ
وَيَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ

وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبۡلُ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَن يَبۡعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ رَسُولٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٞ مُّرۡتَابٌ

ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمۡۖ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٖ جَبَّارٖ
وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ

أَسۡبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٖ

mainSubject.label: Musa's commission with signs and clear authority to Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun, dismissed as magic and lying; the counter-order to kill believing sons while sparing women, itself declared errant; Pharaoh's proposal to kill Musa framed as protecting religion and public order; Musa's refuge-seeking in the shared Lord against arrogance that denies the Day of Account; the concealed believer of Pharaoh's household arguing from evidentiary fairness that a liar bears his own lie while a truthful warner's promise may strike them; his contrast between present dominance and inability to shield from punishment against Pharaoh's self-authorising guidance claim; his warning of a day like the companies repeating the custom of earlier nations, with divine intent excluding injustice; the Day of Calling with futile flight and no guide for the abandoned; Yusuf's prior proofs met with doubt and the post-mortem claim that no messenger would follow; disputation without authority drawing divine and believer hatred and sealing tyrant hearts; the tower project to inspect Musa's deity, its evil made attractive and its plan ruined

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the travel-and-seizure argument (22) before Musa's commission opens (23); P2 ends with Pharaoh's ruined tower plan (37); P3 runs from the believer's invitation through the Fire dialogues (38-50); P4 covers the support promise, patience commands and creation signs to the Be-and-it-is decree (51-68); P5 begins with the disputers' aversion and runs through dragging, livestock signs and the ineffective deathbed faith (69-85).
